scope: All 66 chapter packets, all 439 entries; reports are hash-bound to each packet canonicalEntrySha256.

commentary: sourceContexts[].originalText for relevant verse notes in the chapter context
semanticReviewMethod.principle: Compare the complete range-specific claims and attributions against both supplied primary versions and relevant JFB original commentary. A hash match or schema validation is metadata integrity only and is not evidence of semantic review.

chapters1to43.basis: Chapter-by-chapter reports were reviewed with range-specific reasonJa claims; source and primary comparisons were completed before reports were retained.

chapters44to66.basis: An initial set of summary-opening/boilerplate-generated reports was invalidated and removed. The packets were then reread entry by entry across all four Japanese fields, WEB/KJV range verses, and relevant JFB chapter-context notes; the reports were recreated only after comparison.

meaningFindings.finding: Summary includes vv.2–4 although the entry range and spoilerEnd are v.1.
Summary omits that the righteous person is taken away from coming evil; full-entry revision proposed.
Summary omits the question recalling that God put his Holy Spirit among them; full-entry revision proposed.
Summary omits the selection of priests and Levites in v.21; full-entry revision proposed.

specificRangeEvidence.checks: Primary assertions were compared to both supplied versions; JFB-specific claims including thirst/spirit, Cyrus and Euphrates/Babylon interpretation, and typological readings were checked against original chapter notes and kept attributed.
Compared servant imagery, confession that the servant bears others’ iniquity, the WEB/KJV wording differences in v.8 and v.10–11, and JFB’s messianic/sacrificial reading.

Compared fasting complaint and oppression, concrete release/food/shelter/clothing duties, response and rebuilding promises, and Sabbath condition; JFB interpretations and normative positions were attributed.
Compared temple and humility, offerings/judgment, Zion’s birth, nations and return, renewal, and final carcass/worm/fire image. v.21 omission of priests and Levites was flagged.
